title: Молекулярная кухня и подарки  (Molecular Cuisine and Gifts)

scenes.title: Vika's Late-Night Guest
scenes.summary: Tipsy Nagiyev arrives at Vika's apartment to declare his love, while Vika brings him water and urges him to sleep.

scenes.title: Morning in the Office
scenes.summary: Max wakes Nagiyev before the restaurant opens, and Nagiyev boasts about spending the night talking about love with Vika.

scenes.title: The Missing Lamb Fillet
scenes.summary: Fedya scolds Senya for stealing openly in the kitchen, and Lyova decides to search Senya when lamb fillet goes missing.

scenes.title: Senya's Secret Pocket
scenes.summary: Senya shows Fedya his bottomless pocket and a plastic bottle tied to his leg for smuggling oil out of the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Molecular Cuisine Idea
scenes.summary: Vika asks for a masterclass for the terrace opening, and Katya impresses her by proposing molecular cuisine dishes.

scenes.title: Father and Daughter Argue
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov argues with Katya about tomorrow's masterclass, while Max learns why Vika turned him away last night.

scenes.title: Invitation to Paris
scenes.summary: Max jealously questions Vika at the bar before Nagiyev arrives and invites Vika on a romantic trip to Paris.

scenes.title: The First Woman Who Refused
scenes.summary: Nagiyev marvels at Vika's refusal, while Max pesters Vika about whether she is flying to Paris with Nagiyev.

scenes.title: End-of-Shift Search
scenes.summary: Lyova discovers the bottle tied to Senya's leg and announces personal searches at the end of every workday.

scenes.title: Katya's Triumph on the Terrace
scenes.summary: Guests praise Katya's molecular dishes on the terrace, and she tells Chef Barinov she has been offered a head chef position.

scenes.title: A Toothache and a Talk with Vika
scenes.summary: Senya fakes a toothache in the kitchen while Vika interrupts Chef Barinov's sports match for a serious talk.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's Molecular Banquet
scenes.summary: Vika warns Chef Barinov that a molecular banquet has been booked for tomorrow and begs him to convince Katya to stay.

scenes.title: A Serious Rival
scenes.summary: Fedya hands Senya ice for his tooth, and Max decides to have a man-to-man talk with Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Man-to-Man Talk with Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Nagiyev welcomes a man-to-man talk with Max and reveals that Vika immediately refused his invitation to Paris.

scenes.title: Max's Clever Advice
scenes.summary: Asked for dating advice by Nagiyev, Max claims Vika is a gold digger who demands expensive gifts and jewelry.

scenes.title: Katya's Condition
scenes.summary: Katya says goodbye to the staff and tells her father she will stay only if he appoints her sous-chef of molecular cuisine.

scenes.title: A Veterinarian for Senya
scenes.summary: Senya tries to leave early with a swollen cheek, but Lyova and Fedya discover he is hiding stolen food in his mouth.

scenes.title: A New Car for Vika
scenes.summary: Nagiyev reveals he bought an expensive sports car for Vika based on Max's advice and hands Kostya the keys.

scenes.title: Disaster in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov's molecular dishes turn out rock-hard, breaking Senya's tooth and causing chaos in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Stealing the Car and Calling Katya
scenes.summary: Max decides to hide Nagiyev's new car while Chef Barinov calls Katya to accept her condition and bring her back.
